Changes.note: A medrese given the hosting right can open courses in this köşk; the right gives it no other authority over the köşk. The right is written with who gave it in what role, and to the audit log; the köşk's nazımları, the Medaris nazımları who may give hosting rights and the başnazım see it on this page. Withdrawing it stops the medrese from opening new courses here at once; the withdrawn right stays as history and can be given to the same medrese again. Open courses carry on as they are with “Dersler sürsün”; with “Dersleri gizle” they all leave the lists and talebe can no longer reach their sessions and recordings. Nothing is deleted: hidden courses come back from the Arşiv, and what a Medaris nazımı or the başnazım hid cannot be brought back by the medrese's own head.
